cues: Add each to sodium hydroxide solution.
Ethanol just mixes, with no reaction at all: it is no acid.
But phenol dissolves completely, reacting with the alkali like an acid.
text: Add each to sodium hydroxide solution. Ethanol just mixes, with no reaction at all: it is no acid. But phenol dissolves completely, reacting with the alkali like an acid. It even burns skin.
